turn_text: And they're self-conscious about it. A lot of these pollsters are self-conscious about their own numbers. To their credit, they're releasing them. But they're also doing so with caveats and saying, well, listen, if we weighted it even more, it would be a bigger Democratic vote. Can't blame us. So who knows what to believe? This one is such a pure toss-up that I'm reluctant to give it any rating at all. But I'm going to say, in a nail-bitingly close race, Paxton takes it. But I'm not at all confident in that. I'm putting it in the Republican hold column for now because I'm defaulting to a 50-50 race and defaulting to the fact that a lot of these undecided voters probably voted Republican all their lives and will do so again.

resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Texas US Senate general election. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
